text:
priya_csm: Quick async check-in — AcmeFin renewal is next week and we're seeing an adoption surge on the new live-sync feature. Observations: increase in webhook retries and ~502s from their Dedicated pool.
What I did: triaged customer logs, created incident ticket, asked Acme to pause live-sync, collected sample request IDs.
Blockers: need a rollback plan for the canary model variant and a fix to the webhook handler (timeouts on prefix fetch).
Today: coordinate canary rollback + hotfix + customer comms. @jamal_eng did the canary hit their Dedicated pool last night?

jamal_eng: Checking now — the canary rollout targeted pod-group `dedicated-acme-1` around 03:10 UTC. I manually scaled back replicas to previous revision at 03:45 but the autoscaler spiked briefly. I opened a hotfix branch: `github.com/redwood/inference/commit/abc123` that reduces inflight by setting `BATCH_LIMIT=32`. Recommend testing in staging first. Also suspect KV cache eviction is causing the long tail timeouts.

alex_se: From Acme logs repro: they hit bursts of 3x long sequences (>=2048 tokens) which triggered heavy KV fetch and caused the prefix fetch calls to exceed our timeout. Temporary workaround: add retry header `x-rw-max-retries: 2` on their requests.

mei_support: Acme agreed to a maintenance window tonight 02:00-02:30 PT and asked no key rotations in that slot. They also said they can throttle some upstream jobs during the window.

leo_pm: For the renewal call, I need a mitigation timeline slide. Can we get ETA on a full fix (not just workaround)?

jamal_eng: Patch ETA: code + tests ~2h, review + staging deploy + smoke ~4h. @alex_se can you take the code review? PR: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/4521

alex_se: Will review in ~30m. If green I'll approve and help with staging promote.

priya_csm: Plan: jamal + alex CR -> deploy to staging -> 30m synthetic smoke (I coordinate with Acme) -> promote to prod if stable. I'll draft comms for the renewal team and Acme.

CI-bot: deploy started: staging/dedicated-acme-1 - build 2025.5.13-987 (initiated by jamal_eng)

jamal_eng: Deployed to staging. Quick smoke looks OK: latency back to baseline, no 502s in 15m window. Need approval to promote.

alex_se: +1 from me. @nina_ops any availability to do the production promote at 23:50 UTC?

nina_ops: I can take that window. I'll monitor autoscaler and have rollback steps ready (rollback script: `scripts/prod_rollback.sh`). Please add me to the playbook.

priya_csm: Thanks — I'll update Acme and schedule the renewal call for after the promote. If they experienced measurable impact we'll offer a small credit. Any other blockers?

leo_pm: Please add a QPS quota bump option to the renewal addendum in case they need higher throughput permanently.

priya_csm: Noted. Closing loop here — will post final status after prod promote. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
